llm_analysis.reasoning: Justin's technical depth (72%) is strong on core firmware skills—real-time embedded, motor control, sensor integration, hardware/software integration all have concrete evidence from capstone and production-grade projects. However, the role is mid-level (Engineer II, 3+ years required) and he is entry-level (new grad, 0 full-time years). This is not a skill gap—it's a track-record gap. Technical interviewer would say 'yes, this person can write firmware.' Recruiter would filter on years. Hiring manager would see 'Engineer II scope' and note he needs 6–12 months ramping before independent subsystem ownership. Domain gaps (smartcard, laser, printing) are learnable specializations typical for mid-level onboarding, not blockers.
